# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you identify a potential security vulnerability related to any Pumpnetic smart contract, deployed infrastructure, or this repository, please follow responsible disclosure practices.

**Do not open a public GitHub issue for security vulnerabilities.**

### How to Report

Contact the Pumpnetic team directly:

📧 **[info@pumpnetic.com](mailto:info@pumpnetic.com)**

Subject line: `[SECURITY] Brief description`

Please include:
- The nature of the vulnerability
- The affected contract address or component
- Steps to reproduce (if applicable)
- Your assessment of severity and potential impact

We will acknowledge your report within 48 hours and work to address confirmed issues as quickly as possible.

---

## Scope

| In Scope | Out of Scope |
|---|---|
| Deployed BEP-20 token contracts | Third-party DEX smart contracts (PancakeSwap) |
| Repository content integrity | Community social channels |
| Official website infrastructure | Personal user wallets |

---

---

## Known Limitations

- Pumpnetic tokens are meme and culture tokens deployed without formal third-party audits
- All contracts use OpenZeppelin-based patterns and are publicly verifiable
- Users should independently verify contract source code before participating
